reviewNotes: Twenty-five event dialogue, festival prompts, counters, and responses were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover gender-neutral player references, exact dialogue command structure, placeholders, response IDs, established festival terminology, punctuation, and register; both found no remaining objective issue.

Event.cs.1309.source: I'm so proud of you, my boy!^I'm so proud of you, my dear!#$b#You've really turned the place around since we last spoke!#$b#You're a better farmer than I ever was, and you've brought great honor to the family name.#$b#I can feel it now... My spirit is finally put to rest. Bless you.
Event.cs.1309.translation: Sunt atât de mândru de tine, băiatul meu!^Sunt atât de mândru de tine, draga mea!#$b#Ai transformat cu adevărat locul de când am vorbit ultima dată!#$b#Te pricepi la agricultură mai bine decât m-am priceput eu vreodată și ai adus mare cinste numelui familiei.#$b#O simt acum... Spiritul meu și-a găsit în sfârșit odihna. Dumnezeu să te binecuvânteze.

Event.cs.1315.source: The farm hasn't changed much in these past few years... but that's okay.#$b#If you're enjoying your new life, that's all that matters to me...
Event.cs.1315.translation: Ferma nu s-a schimbat prea mult în ultimii ani... dar nu-i nimic.#$b#Dacă îți place noua ta viață, doar asta contează pentru mine...

Event.cs.1316.source: You've done a good job with the place.#$b#It seems you've tried your best... that's all I can ask for. I'm proud of you.
Event.cs.1316.translation: Ai făcut treabă bună cu locul acesta.#$b#Se vede că ai făcut tot ce ai putut... asta este tot ce pot cere. Sunt mândru de tine.

Event.cs.1317.source: You've done well, my boy.^You've done well, my dear.#$b#%farm Farm has never looked better. It's an honor to the family name.#$b#Grandpa is pleased.
Event.cs.1317.translation: Te-ai descurcat bine, băiatul meu.^Te-ai descurcat bine, draga mea.#$b#Ferma %farm nu a arătat niciodată mai bine. Face cinste numelui familiei.#$b#Bunicul este mulțumit.

Event.cs.1318.source: I'm so proud of you, my boy!^I'm so proud of you, my dear!#$b#You're a better farmer than I ever was, and you've brought great honor to the family name.#$b#I can feel it now... My spirit is finally put to rest. Bless you.
Event.cs.1318.translation: Sunt atât de mândru de tine, băiatul meu!^Sunt atât de mândru de tine, draga mea!#$b#Te pricepi la agricultură mai bine decât m-am priceput eu vreodată și ai adus mare cinste numelui familiei.#$b#O simt acum... Spiritul meu și-a găsit în sfârșit odihna. Dumnezeu să te binecuvânteze.

Event.cs.1497.source: Um, excuse me.#$b#I have a gift for you. I found it last summer when I was playing at the beach. I hope you like it.$h
Event.cs.1497.translation: Ăă, scuză-mă.#$b#Am un cadou pentru tine. L-am găsit vara trecută, când mă jucam pe plajă. Sper să-ți placă.$h

Event.cs.1498.source: I'm glad you moved here, farmer @!$h
Event.cs.1498.translation: Mă bucur că te-ai mutat aici, @!$h

Event.cs.1499.source: Hey, @. I'm your secret gift-giver this year.#$b#Here, open it.$h
Event.cs.1499.translation: Hei, @. Anul acesta, eu îți ofer cadoul secret.#$b#Poftim, deschide-l.$h

Event.cs.1500.source: It's not much, but I hope you like it.$h
Event.cs.1500.translation: Nu este mare lucru, dar sper să-ți placă.$h

Event.cs.1501.source: Hi. So, I'm your secret gift-giver this year.#$b#Well? Open it!
Event.cs.1501.translation: Bună. Așadar, anul acesta eu îți ofer cadoul secret.#$b#Ei bine? Deschide-l!

Event.cs.1504.source: It's nothing fancy, but it's the best I could afford.
Event.cs.1504.translation: Nu este ceva sofisticat, dar este tot ce mi-am putut permite.

Event.cs.1524.translation: $q -1 null#Ei bine, începem dansul acum?#$r -1 0 yes#Da, să începem.#$r -1 0 no#Încă nu.

Event.cs.1531.source: $q -1 null#What do you think... should I launch the boat now?#$r -1 0 yes#Yes.#$r -1 0 no#Not yet.

Event.cs.1548.source: $q -1 null#Are you ready to participate in the ice fishing competition?#$r -1 0 yes#Yes.#$r -1 0 no#Not yet.

Event.cs.1584.source: Your grange display has been judged. Return to Mayor Lewis for the result!
Event.cs.1584.translation: Expoziția ta agricolă a fost evaluată. Întoarce-te la primarul Lewis pentru rezultat!

Event.cs.1632.source: Of course I'll dance with you!$h
Event.cs.1632.translation: Bineînțeles că voi dansa cu tine!$h

Event.cs.1633.source: You want to be my partner for the flower dance?#$b#Okay. I look forward to it.$h
Event.cs.1633.translation: Vrei să dansăm împreună la Dansul Florilor?#$b#Bine. Abia aștept.$h

Event.cs.1634.source: You want to be my partner for the flower dance?#$b#Okay! I'd love to.$h
Event.cs.1634.translation: Vrei să dansăm împreună la Dansul Florilor?#$b#Bine! Mi-ar face plăcere.$h

Event.cs.1635.source: I'm sorry... I already have a partner.
Event.cs.1635.translation: Îmi pare rău... am deja cu cine să dansez.
